name: PC Throttle
summary: Throttle, bench test and firmware update tool for novaX ESCs on a PC, through the FC or a USB-CAN adapter (Windows).

shots.caption: Main screen: throttle, ESC status, thrust stand and the live thrust chart
Update every ESC: all five ESCs on the CAN hub listed, one after another

releases.changes: "Update every ESC" now lists every ESC on a CAN hub: names are asked one ESC at a time and asked again until they answer (before, 2 of 5 ESCs behind an FC were listed). The version and build are shown in the window.

files.notes: Needs Microsoft Edge WebView2 (built into Windows 11).
